_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Baggage Resolution Center Daily Log
summary: The Baggage Resolution Center Daily Log documents the status of contractors' efforts to resolve mishandled baggage claims, used by the government to identify trends and create a monthly report.
use_relationship:
The Baggage Resolution Center Daily Log documents the status of the contractors' effort towards achieving contract objectives. It identifies open and resolved mishandled baggage claims. The Daily Log will be utilized by the government to identify average resolution time, locations with high loss rates, and to create a monthly report.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Baggage Resolution Center Daily Log shall be in Microsoft Access or Microsoft Excel format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Baggage Resolution Center Daily Log shall contain the following:

children.title: Global Air Transportation Execution System (GATES)-generated Baggage Service Center (BSC) Case File Number
Passenger name associated with the BSC Case File Number
Number of bags associated with each claim
Branch of service of each passenger filing a baggage claim
Type of baggage claim (e.g., lost, found, damaged, or pilfered)
Air carrier name associated with each baggage claim
Reporting station that initiated each baggage claim
Status of each baggage claim (e.g., baggage received, forms sent, duplicate case file)
Date on which reimbursement message, baggage form, and Air Mobility Command (AMC) Form 134 were sent to each passenger for damaged, lost, or pilfered baggage claims
Additional remarks (e.g., follow-up email sent to passenger, passenger responded, passenger did not submit baggage form)
Number of open mishandled baggage claims
Number of resolved mishandled baggage claims, to include:
Number of claims resolved by bag returned to the passenger
Number of claims directed to Department of Defense (DoD) for reimbursement or to contract air carrier for reimbursement
